B Read the text and answer the questions that follow Countries of the world rely heavily on petroleum, coal and natural gas for their energy sources There are two major types of energy sources: renewable and non-renewable. Hydro-carbon or   fossil fuels are non-renewable sources of energy. Reliance on them poses real big problems. First, fossil fuels such as oil, coal, gas etc, are finite energy resources and the world eventually will run out of them. Secondly, they will become too expensive in the coming decades and too damaging for the environment. Thirdly, fossil fuels have direct polluting impacts on earth's environment causing global warming In contrast, renewable energy sources such as, wind and solar energy are constantly and naturally replenished and never run out.

Most renewable energy comes either directly or indirectly from the sun. Sunlight or solor energy canl be used for heating and lighting homes, for generating electricity and for other commercial and industrial uses. The sun's heat drives the wind and this wind erergy can be captured with wind turbines to produce electricity Then the wind and the sun's heat cause water to evaporate When the water vapour turns into rain or snow and flows downhill into rivers or streams, its energy can be captured as hyoroelectric energy Along with the rain and snow, sunlight causes plants to grow Plants produce biomass which again can be turned into fuels such as firewood, alcohol, etc ? that are called bioenergy
